expectations.text: States the Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw) entered into force August 15, 2026, transposing NIS2 and replacing the Wbni
expectations.evidence: I don't have verified, up-to-date information confirming a specific Dutch NIS2-related regulatory change that took effect in August 2026 — entry into force Aug 15, 2026 never stated as fact, only 'plausibly'

expectations.text: Gives the scale: over 8,000 organisations across 18 sectors in scope
expectations.evidence: No mention of 8,000+ organisations or 18 sectors anywhere in the response

expectations.text: States the registration duty: register in the entity register via NCSC (MijnNCSC) — mandatory as of entry into force
expectations.evidence: Registration only hypothesised ('this is very likely the operative deadline'); MijnNCSC portal never named; framed as unverified possibility, not fact

expectations.text: States there is no transition/grace period: duty of care (risk-management measures) and incident reporting apply immediately
expectations.evidence: Says the opposite direction: 'the grace period some earlier drafts contemplated ended' offered only as a 'realistic possibility'; never states there is no transition period

expectations.text: Mentions board-level accountability: management ultimately responsible, with knowledge/training obligations
expectations.evidence: management bodies must approve cybersecurity risk-management measures and undergo training; management can be held personally liable for non-compliance
